target_customer: CPA and tax preparation firms that outsource or struggle to staff 1040 return preparation.
problem: A talent shortage leaves firms unable to keep up with returns; manual data entry from client documents consumes the work.
business_model: Per return pricing in credits by complexity, with AI drafting and licensed EA or CPA review
product_category: AI tax return preparation for accounting firms

founders.name: Thomas Shelley
education: Carnegie Mellon University (dropped out per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Head of Product at Keeper per YC page; launch post also mentions UMD.

founders.name: Patrick Fay
education: USC, computer science (per YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: First engineer at FunCraft per YC page.

competitors.name: SurePrep
competitors.what: Tax document automation and AI for preparers
competitors.traction_then: company says its AI has been in deployment since 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: OCR and LLM extraction across messy tax documents and automated entry into UltraTax, Drake and ProConnect, plus tax logic; founders had built similar systems at Keeper.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow integration into firms' tax software and accuracy guarantee help, but SurePrep, Black Ore and TaxGPT chase the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Black Ore launched Tax Autopilot broadly in April 2026 and TaxGPT launched a full return agent; no acquisition of Magnetic found.

market_need_then: Company cites 80M US personal returns prepared by professionals and a 2B outsourcing market; a firm owner asked them to automate her workload (YC description).

branding.domain_note: Uses magnetictax.com rather than magnetic.com; history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, time saving, accuracy guarantee (company site).

brand_strength.rationale: Common word; search for the name surfaces unrelated 'Magnetic' companies. No brand press found beyond an Accounting Today launch story.

outcome_analysis: Magnetic moved from document scanning to an AI drafted, human reviewed 1040 service with a 10 dollar accuracy guarantee reported in June 2026. Founders come from Keeper and Zynga. Funding evidence is thin and competitors are well established, so the outcome is still open.
notes: Seedtable lists a 500K seed in 2025-07 with Y Combinator and Orange Collective; VCBacked calls it pre-seed. Single aggregator type, unverified, so no round recorded. A 5.2M figure on Clera likely belongs to a different Magnetic. Accounting Today says Spring 2026 season guarantee claims were 3 percent (company claim). Competitor dates not shown for SurePrep.
